pp2.10:1.2: Sattakkhattuṃ paramassa kolaṅkolassa ekabījissa sakadāgāmissa yo ca ditth' eva dhamme arahā,
pp2.10:2.2: Antarāparinibbāyissa upahaccaparinibbāyissa asaṅkharaparinibbāyissa sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyissa uddhaṃsotassa akaniṭṭhagāmino
pp2.10:2.3: imesaṃ pañcannaṃ idha vihāya niṭṭhā ti.
pp2.10:3.1: Ettāvatā puggalānaṃ puggalapaññattī ti. PUGGALAPAÑÑATTI NIṬṬHITĀ.
